dedupeText: urban graffiti illustration album art graffiti wall cartoon portrait orange and black hand drawn lettering street art aesthetic character in foreground interacting with a canvas dense graffiti background contrasting with solid top header repetitive orange linework on dark charcoal walls central easel acting as a secondary focal point combine a solid color header with a dark textured background filled with hand drawn scribbles in the header color place a stylized character in the foreground with high contrast accents like gold to create an urban hip hop aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant urban illustration featuring a stylized character in front of a wall densely covered in hand-drawn graffiti and scribbles.

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat-style cartoon character with prominent gold teeth and jewelry sits in the foreground, positioned against a dark corner wall that is completely saturated with orange hand-drawn tags, lyrics, and symbols. The top third of the composition is a solid, vibrant orange block.
coreVisualRelationships: Character in foreground interacting with a canvas
Dense graffiti background contrasting with solid top header
Repetitive orange linework on dark charcoal walls
Central easel acting as a secondary focal point
coreInvariants: High-contrast orange and charcoal color palette
Hand-drawn, non-uniform scribble texture across the background
Stylized character with simplified geometric features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main character is in the lower-left foreground, scaled to occupy about one-third of the width, while the easel is centered.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's bright yellow gold teeth and the white canvas in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the solid orange header down to the large text, then follow the graffiti patterns to the character and the central canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the solid orange top bar provides the only significant area of visual rest.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation orange against low-value dark grey creates a glowing, neon-like effect for the graffiti.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn block letters and cursive scripts
letterConstructionRules: Letters often outlined in orange with no fill
Varying scales and orientations to mimic street tags
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into banners or underlined with jagged strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Layering large outlined block letters with smaller, dense cursive 'tags' to create a chaotic urban texture.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the street art aesthetic of the background
Mimics the raw, unpolished look of the scribbles

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital illustration of a dark charcoal room corner with a solid orange top border. Fill the walls with dense, orange hand-drawn graffiti, scribbles, and symbols. Place a cartoon character with gold teeth in the lower left and a white canvas on an easel in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, hand-drawn orange outlined block lettering in the upper right area. Scatter smaller cursive tags and repetitive text patterns across the remaining wall space to complete the graffiti effect.

verificationChecks: Is the top bar a solid, flat orange?
Does the graffiti look hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Is the contrast between the orange lines and charcoal wall high?
Are the gold teeth a prominent visual anchor?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand-identifying marks
The specific facial features of the character to avoid likeness issues
The exact wording of the background tags
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text is legible against the dark background
Check that the character's gold teeth are bright yellow
Verify the 'corner' perspective of the walls is maintained
Confirm the top orange bar is perfectly horizontal and solid
Ensure no real-world logos are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [solid color header] with a [dark textured background] filled with [hand-drawn scribbles in the header color]. Place a [stylized character] in the foreground with [high-contrast accents like gold] to create an urban hip-hop aesthetic.
